steps.title: Prepare and Anaesthesize Animal
steps.instruction: Prepare the animal for surgery according to approved institutional and veterinary guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Anaesthesize the animal and provide analgesics and necessary medications.
Shave the animal's scalp.
Transfer the animal to a stereotaxic frame with a heating pad to maintain body temperature.
Fix the animal's head in the stereotaxic frame and level the head with the stereotax.

steps.title: Expose the Skull
steps.instruction: Prepare the surgical site and expose the skull.

substeps.instruction: Apply local anaesthetics and/or eye ointments if applicable.
Clean the scalp according to approved protocol.
Make an anterior to posterior midline incision to expose the skull.
Use sterile cotton swabs and sterile saline to clean the incision and skull and gently part the skin.
Ensure the skull is completely dry.

steps.title: Level the Head
steps.instruction: Use bregma and lambda to precisely level the head in the stereotaxic frame using a drill bit attached to a stereotax arm.

substeps.instruction: Adjust ear bars until bregma and lambda have the same medio-lateral (ML) position.
Adjust position until bregma and lambda have the same dorso-ventral (DV) position.
Identify two points 2.0 mm behind bregma and 2.5 mm to either side of midline (AP -2.0 mm, ML ±2.5 mm) and adjust until they have the same DV position.
Repeat these adjustments multiple times if necessary to ensure accuracy.

steps.title: Perform Craniotomy
steps.instruction: Create access holes for the injection.

substeps.instruction: Use a drill to make small craniotomy holes over the target region using the same ML and AP coordinates as the injection site.
Use an angled injection strategy if the hole is placed directly over large surface blood vessels to avoid bleeding.

steps.title: Prepare Injection Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up the microsyringe and pump system.

substeps.instruction: Fill a 10 μL Nanofil microsyringe (World Precision Instruments) and NanoFil microinjection needle (33 or 35 Gauge blunt) with the reagent.
Mount the UMP3 microsyringe pump (World Precision Instruments) onto the stereotax arm and attach the needle.
Connect the pump to the Micro4 microsyringe pump controller (World Precision Instruments).
Use the controller to expel a small amount of liquid until a droplet appears on the needle tip, then remove the droplet with a sterile cotton swab to ensure no air is in the needle.

steps.title: Perform Intracranial Injection
steps.instruction: Inject the reagent into the target brain region.

substeps.instruction: Zero the needle tip on bregma or the brain surface.
Lower the needle through the craniotomy hole to the desired depth.
Record the approximate volume of liquid in the syringe at the start of the injection.
Program the controller to inject the desired amount of reagent over a period of 5-10 min.
Execute the injection and verify that the correct volume was expelled into the tissue at the end.

steps.title: Post-Injection Wait and Withdrawal
steps.instruction: Allow the reagent to diffuse and carefully remove the needle.

substeps.instruction: Wait at least 5-10 mins after the controller stops injecting before moving the needle to mitigate backflow.
Withdraw the microinjection needle slowly to reduce backflow up the needle tract.

steps.title: Repeat for Additional Sites
steps.instruction: If multiple sites are required, repeat the injection process.

substeps.instruction: Gently clean the microinjection needle with sterile saline and a cotton swab when moving between craniotomy holes.
Move the needle to the next injection site and repeat the injection steps.

steps.title: Surgical Closure and Recovery
steps.instruction: Close the surgical site and provide post-operative care.

substeps.instruction: Close the incision with suture.
Transfer the animal back to the home cage.
Provide necessary post-operative medications and care.
